capabilities: render Wardley Maps from wardleymap code blocks in notes
edit maps in the OnlineWardleyMaps format
extras: README warns the plugin requires a recent Obsidian installer version and gives update instructions if it fails to load.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display or edit Wardley Maps, a diagram format used for strategy mapping.

relations.evidence: displaying and editing of Wardley Maps in the OnlineWardleyMaps format

summary: Renders and edits Wardley Maps inside notes via wardleymap code blocks using the OnlineWardleyMaps (OWM) format.
